query:
SELECT order_id, total_cents, total_cents / 100.0 AS total_units
FROM Orders
WHERE order_id IN (101, 102)
ORDER BY order_id;

SELECT order_id, customer_id, total_cents
FROM Orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
  AND (customer_id = 1 OR total_cents >= 2000)
ORDER BY order_id;

SELECT order_id, ordered_on
FROM Orders
ORDER BY ordered_on DESC, order_id DESC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT customer_id, name, COALESCE(city, '(unknown)') AS city_label
FROM Customers
WHERE city <> 'Oslo' OR city IS NULL
ORDER BY customer_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count,
       SUM(total_cents) AS total_cents,
       AVG(total_cents * 1.0) AS average_cents,
       MIN(total_cents) AS smallest, MAX(total_cents) AS largest
FROM Orders;

SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders, SUM(total_cents) AS paid_cents
FROM Orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING SUM(total_cents) >= 2500
ORDER BY customer_id;

SELECT o.order_id, c.name, o.total_cents
FROM Orders AS o
INNER JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_id <= 103
ORDER BY o.order_id;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS paid_orders
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN Orders AS o
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY c.customer_id;

SELECT o.order_id, o.total_cents,
       SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_cents) AS line_total_cents
FROM Orders AS o
JOIN OrderItems AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.total_cents
ORDER BY o.order_id;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.name
FROM Customers AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM Orders AS o
  WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'paid'
)
ORDER BY c.customer_id;

WITH Totals AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_cents) AS cents
  FROM Orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT c.name, t.cents
FROM Totals AS t
JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.cents >= 3000
ORDER BY c.customer_id;

SELECT customer_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count
FROM Orders
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY customer_id;

SELECT order_id, total_cents,
  SUM(total_cents) OVER (
    PARTITION BY customer_id
    ORDER BY ordered_on, order_id
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_cents
FROM Orders
WHERE customer_id = 1
ORDER BY ordered_on, order_id;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders
FROM Customers AS c
LEFT JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY c.customer_id;

SELECT customer_id, name, city
FROM Customers WHERE customer_id = 4;
SELECT order_id, status FROM Orders WHERE order_id = 102;

SELECT customer_id, name
FROM Customers
WHERE city = ?
ORDER BY customer_id;

SELECT order_id, ordered_on
FROM Orders
WHERE customer_id = 1
  AND ordered_on >= '2026-01-01' AND ordered_on < '2026-02-01'
ORDER BY ordered_on, order_id;

SELECT order_id
FROM Orders
WHERE ordered_on >= '2026-01-01' AND ordered_on < '2026-02-01'
ORDER BY order_id;
SELECT order_id, status FROM Orders WHERE order_id = 102;

SELECT order_id, ordered_on
FROM Orders
WHERE ordered_on < '2026-02-02'
   OR (ordered_on = '2026-02-02' AND order_id < 105)
ORDER BY ordered_on DESC, order_id DESC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT city FROM Customers WHERE customer_id IN (1, 2)
UNION
SELECT city FROM Customers WHERE customer_id = 4
ORDER BY city;
